description: This file defines a Java class 'Grid' that represents a 2D rectangular mesh for graphics rendering, supporting textured or untextured drawing using OpenGL ES.

classes.name: Grid
classes.description: A class representing a 2D rectangular mesh used for OpenGL rendering, supporting textured/untextured rendering, vertex and texture coordinate buffers, and index buffers.

methods.name: Grid
methods.description: Constructor that initializes buffers and index data for a grid mesh with specified width and height.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets vertex position and texture coordinates for a specific grid cell (i, j).

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the grid using OpenGL, with an option to use textures.
